candidates.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
candidates.summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

candidates.title: How Ninth Wave built AI-powered open finance onboarding on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Learn how Ninth Wave built Compass, a multi-agent AI onboarding assistant on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that validates bank APIs against Financial Data Exchange (FDX) standards, scores compliance, and compresses open finance onboarding from weeks to minutes while meeting SOC 2 and PCI DSS requirements.

candidates.title: Only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: What happens when OpenAI ships your roadmap?
candidates.summary: If you're building an AI company, the question isn't whether foundation models will continue to evolve. It's whether your company will continue creating value as they do. Don't miss this interactive session on the Builders Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

candidates.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
candidates.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

candidates.title: The generative AI customization spectrum: From prompt engineering to custom models on AWS
candidates.summary: Pick the right generative AI customization approach on AWS with an 8-step decision framework, from prompt engineering and RAG to fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and Amazon Nova Forge. Start simple and escalate only when you must.

candidates.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
candidates.summary: The notetaker offers a generous free plan, and that has resulted in over 400,000 monthly active users. The company said that over 1 million people have recorded meetings until now.
